title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZH (Donation or subscription by Producer Company)

content.overview: A Producer Company may, by special resolution, donate or subscribe to an institution or individual for the specified social and economic welfare purposes or to promote mutual assistance principles. The aggregate amount in a financial year must not exceed three per cent of the company's net profit in the immediately preceding financial year. The section prohibits direct or indirect contributions or subscriptions to political parties or for political purposes, and making facilities, including personnel or material, available for those purposes.
content.glance: Section 378ZH permits qualifying donations/subscriptions by special resolution, capped at 3% of the preceding financial year's net profit, and prohibits political contributions, subscriptions and facilities.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZH (Donation or subscription by Producer Company). By special resolution, a Producer Company may make a donation or subscription to an institution or individual for promoting the social and economic welfare of Producer Members, producers or the general public, or for promoting mutual assistance principles. The aggregate of all such donations and subscriptions in a financial year must not exceed three per cent of the net profit in the immediately preceding financial year. The section also prohibits directly or indirectly making any contribution or subscription to a political party or for any political purpose to any person, or making facilities, including personnel or material, available for such purposes. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Permitted purposes and approval
sections.body: A Producer Company may, by special resolution, make a donation or subscription to an institution or individual for promoting the social and economic welfare of Producer Members, producers or the general public, or for promoting mutual assistance principles.

sections.heading: Annual aggregate cap
sections.body: The aggregate amount of all donations and subscriptions in a financial year must not exceed three per cent of the Producer Company's net profit in the financial year immediately preceding the financial year in which the donation or subscription is made.

sections.heading: Political contribution and facility prohibition
sections.body: A Producer Company must not directly or indirectly make a contribution or subscription to a political party or for any political purpose to any person, or make available facilities including personnel or material for such purposes.

examples.title: Reviewing a proposed donation
examples.body: Check that a special resolution is passed, the recipient and purpose fit the statutory categories, the aggregate for the financial year remains within three per cent of the preceding financial year's net profit, and the donation or related facilities are not for a political party or political purpose.

hypotheticals.question: A Producer Company proposes a donation that would cause the year's aggregate donations to exceed three per cent of the previous financial year's net profit. What does section 378ZH require?
hypotheticals.analysis: Calculate the aggregate donations and subscriptions for the financial year and compare them with three per cent of the net profit in the immediately preceding financial year. A special resolution does not remove the statutory cap. Also check the permitted-purpose and political-contribution restrictions.

distinctions.title: Permitted welfare/mutual-assistance donations and political-purpose support
distinctions.left: Donations/subscriptions for the welfare and mutual-assistance purposes specified in section 378ZH, subject to special resolution and the annual cap.
distinctions.right: Direct or indirect contributions/subscriptions to political parties or political purposes, or making facilities available for those purposes, are prohibited by the section.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming a special resolution permits donations for any purpose or above the statutory cap.
misconceptions.correction: The purpose categories and the three-per-cent annual aggregate cap continue to apply.

misconceptions.trap: Calculating the cap against the current year's net profit.
misconceptions.correction: The cap is measured against net profit in the immediately preceding financial year.

misconceptions.trap: Treating indirect political support or provision of facilities as outside the prohibition.
misconceptions.correction: The section covers direct and indirect contributions/subscriptions and facilities including personnel or material.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does section 378zh do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: A Producer Company may make donations or subscriptions to any institution or individual for the objects the section permits, subject to the limits and the approval the section requires.
